verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents official Web and Mobile SDKs (get-started, customization, accessibility, permalinks) plus a REST API and, notably for agenticness, an official MCP server letting AI agents perform Sumsub operations under existing role permissions. This directly satisfies 'build against official SDKs' including an AI-native integration path. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe returned 404s), no independent/third-party corroboration of SDK quality, and no explicit repo/version details for the Mobile SDKs.
